newsitems.title: Patch 2.0.2
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [h2]Performance[/h2][list][*][p]Improved rendering performance in the mission select screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Pattern Infusion[/h2][list][*][p]Increased how much upgrade stats are increased from being infused with a larger pattern[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased how much upgrade stats are decreased from being infused with a smaller pattern[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upgrades[/h2][list][*][p]Mycologist’s Eye of the Storm upgrade consumes infection as you fire it. The amount of decay applied by this upgrade is based on how infected you are before you begin firing.[/p][list][*][p]With Eye of the Storm Equipped, you can still tap the util button to create a Fungal Skewer[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in Engineered Infection’s description[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Glider’s Star Fuel upgrade decreasing its fly duration stat instead of increasing it when infused with a larger pattern[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where health chunks spawned by the Carver’s Sharing Lunch upgrade weren’t healing allies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you couldn’t equip hollow employee upgrades at the same time as a hollow cryo upgrade[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]The Mycologist’s cape is no longer missing[/p][/*][*][p]The Swarm Launcher’s reload animation resets correctly when unequipping the Telepathic Charging skin[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up a new weapon (like in Oxythane Breach) no longer plays the exotic pickup sound for other players[/p][/*][*][p]Snowstorms work correctly in the Ice Floes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where if you were holding a barrel and threw your Rocket Lasso it would lasso the barrel back to you[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the ‘friendly fire’ end of mission stat to ‘self damage’ since the only friendly fire damage you can deal in a mission is self damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some new achievements not retroactively unlocking[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where controller look speed wasn’t consistent at different FPS[/p][/*][*][p]\[PC] Fixed some issues with screen resolution settings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Drop Pod[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that would sometimes delete the material from certain terminals in the HUB if you had a Drop Pod skin equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Oxythane Drop Pod skin was turning the pod yellow instead of blue. Let’s just chalk it up to colorblindness.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Enemy Intensity[/h2][list][*][p]You may have noticed the options for enemy intensity are GONE, and we may have forgotten to say anything about that in the launch patch notes. With full release (and our previous major update) we’ve been making substantial changes to how enemy swarms spawn and intensity has become more dynamic. The intensity levels actually stopped doing anything along with the Freeze & Fester update, but with full release we finally got around to removing intensity buttons from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemy intensity levels were still visible in the mission info screen if you open your inventory during a mission[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]When joining an in-progress game, a bug can cause your equipped guns to not be audible. If you’re using the Plate Launcher, this also makes the plate not recall correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Gunship Cannon Prism stats only increase a miniscule amount when infused with a larger pattern[/p][/*][*][p]Hunk garages in Paid Time Off can sometimes spawn partially underground[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Patch 2.0.1
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][p]- Fixed the Fulfillment for activating relay towers not progressing[/p][p]- Fixed the Fulfillment for collecting Saxito bags not progressing[/p][p]- Fixed the Cranius achievement not unlocking[/p][p]- Fixed the Bunker Buster achievement not unlocking[/p][p]- Darkened a couple rooms in the HUB[/p][p]- Fixed some translations[/p][p]- Fixed missing translations in Oxythane Breach
[/p][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][p]- Equipping a Drop Pod skin can cause certain light materials to go missing until you restart. We have fixes for this and a bunch of other things coming in the next patch![/p]

newsitems.title: 1.0 IS HERE!!!
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [p]Mycopunk is officially fully released![/p][p]It is incredible that this is the last blog post to be making during Early Access, and we couldn’t be any happier with what we’ve been able to put together for 1.0. Thank you for signing up with Saxon’s Early Access program, and be rest assured, there’s more Mycopunk on the way…[/p][p]But for now, enjoy 1.0 and all its upgrades, secrets, improvements, and loads of polish. We’ll be off getting hammered :}[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]The Supporter Pack[/h1][p]If you love Mycopunk and want to throw your support our way, you can take a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5092090?beta=0"]look at the Supporter Pack here[/url]! It comes with some fun skins and other cosmetics, but mostly it shows us you like what we’re doing <3[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5092090/Mycopunk__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]1.0 is also releasing with a [b]50% launch discount[/b], so it's the perfect time to convince that one friend to join you...[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8e5073561db008342ab0c0f1d33d19e2de78c4a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]The Big Ones[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Employee - The Mycologist[/h2][p]A member of the first expedition to New Atlas after the fungal outbreak, the Mycologist has been trapped planet-side (moon-side??) for over a year. This has made her… a little strange.[/p][p]We’ve been working on the Mycologist for quite a while and we think you’ll have a lot of fun with her set of upgrades and her abilities: [b]Sporelift[/b] and [b]Fungal Skewer[/b]. Plus, a passive [b]infection[/b] ability… But first, you’ll have to rescue her in [b]Expedition Alpha.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/75645ecaf386cc03edcd06cc1dfc4de3dd8d0931.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Mission - Population Control[/h2][p]A new normal mission! Clear out areas of high enemy density, and maybe tussle with a couple Abominations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/e6633a17a4d4923aec8fc49d726750b59f5f748c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Mini Special Assignment - The Couch[/h2][p]Help Roachard find the perfect fit and rescue a couch for the HUB.[/p][p]Also you now can sit in some chairs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/48f02791c03f99bc722e2f2e4f17f7fb328bbaea.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Weapon - The Diffraction Driver[/h2][p]An ion scattergun that fires in a short-range cone. You can spin up its halo to make the cone smaller and longer. This weapon can be unlocked with some resources after you reach level 10.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/b8ff0fb686e94af6c7e23ca7432f6455eac3fd2b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Snowball Grenade[/h2][p]A cryo grenade! The Snowball is unlocked from X11-B.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/3e8b81b10451d44526f66b62b27d7d560f05194e.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]X11-B[/h2][p]A new region on New Atlas’ moonlet. X11-B’s difficult missions will test your best loadouts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/77903567e7460811b547f00ccdead832e40621a8.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Hats[/h2][p]You can wear hats. On your head. Most hats come from the new Fulfillments![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/839debeaa458fa79355d109d30ddb33b125e339d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Fulfillments[/h2][p]An in-game achievement system for tracking your mastery and watching a big number go up. Many Fulfillments reward cosmetics.[/p][p]Some Fulfillments are retroactive and some aren’t, depending on which stats we were already tracking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8c796e5a01bde953609c0ce7493046c6b5d472e4.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Sit Emotes[/h2][p]Each employee has a default sit emote! Time to plant yer ass and watch your friends do the mission.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/9c0fbdceb8f6204991fd84a474cc8a7cbc848d8d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]HUB Rework[/h2][p]It’s cool. Just check it out for yourself.[/p][p]Daily Lottery Larry tokens must be wrestled from the cold hands of Golden Bruce.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/4dae41c2b326bcd90132fdbd944324a4d4c93ff7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Drop Pod Redesign[/h2][p]The drop pod has a new design! Your old skins have been ported to the new model.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/7d7be634581c5fce3dabb261e2e99ce9f9607b44.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]The Other Ones[/h1][p][/p][h2]Mission Failure[/h2][p]If no one successfully gets in the Drop Pod, the mission is failed.[/p][p][/p][h2]Loadouts[/h2][list][*][p]Loadout buttons are highlighted when they are equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over a loadout lists out its upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few more loadout icons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p]All text is now translated![/p][/*][*][p]Improved how text is displayed in Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some text would display the wrong characters in Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where text could overflow Roachard’s in-mission dialogue box in non-English languages[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Enemies[/h2][list][*][p]Missilehead[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Missileheads would begin to fire all four missile shells at the same time if they were left alive for long enough[/p][/*][*][p]Missileheads attack slower and deal less damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Devastator’s gravity surge field is smaller[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly lowered the max enemy count when playing solo on threat 3-4[/p][/*][*][p]Lasers[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that wouldn’t despawn an enemy’s laser if you weren’t the host and the laser emitter lost line-of-sight with you while firing[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy laser sounds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Explosive barrel enemies respect death protection if you’re close to the edge of their explosion radius[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to get stuck in the same place forever if they were ragdolled and frozen at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bit more downtime after clearing large waves of enemies in Paid Time Off[/p][/*][*][p]Optical Jammer[/p][list][*][p]Reduced enemy Optical Jammer health[/p][/*][*][p]Optical Jammers are less abundant[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy Autocannon fire rate[/p][/*][*][p]Amalgamation[/p][list][*][p]The Amalgamation spawns with fewer legs, making it easier to hit its shells[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the chance of getting Amalgamation exotics from Amalgamation Hunt repeat rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Repeat Amalgamation Hunt completions always drop a Uniform skin[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overclocked Enemies[/p][list][*][p]Overclocked explosions deal way more damage to enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Overclocked explosions deal increased damage to enemies on higher threat levels[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hornets can be frozen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the following enemy parts would keep firing while they were frozen: Missilehead Arrays, Missile Arrays, Grenade Spewers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Crafting & Resources[/h2][list][*][p]Crafting undiscovered upgrades costs more normal resources and less Saxonite[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance of getting Saxonite from completing missions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Controls[/h2][list][*][p]Improved quip wheel interaction when using a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Inspecting weapons on a controller is now done through the quip wheel[/p][/*][*][p]When using a controller and riding a Blitseg in first person, your camera auto-centers after you stop moving the look stick[/p][/*][*][p]You can hold the melee button on controller to continuously melee[/p][/*][*][p]Turbocharge is no longer bound to the same key as select when using a controller[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]HUD[/h2][list][*][p]Damage numbers and text (like IGNITE/IMMUNE) can be disabled separately in the gameplay options[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Autosprint[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with auto-sprint where you wouldn’t resume sprinting if you stopped aiming while still firing on a gun that can fire while sprinting[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Mission Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Planetary Defense - The railgun automatically begins rotating after its batteries land[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple turrets in Oxythane Breach that were floating or clipping through geometry[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Roachard’s first voiceline in Oxythane Breach getting cut off[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing sounds in Oxythane Breach for unlocking doors and overloading the reactor[/p][/*][*][p]Prized Possession door keys can’t be interacted with after unlocking the door[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the amount of kills required for background tasks to kill enemies with a specific weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Overtime Assignment & Ouroboros backlog tasks won’t appear until you’ve unlocked their respective missions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Backlog tasks could reward a level-up for a weapon you hadn’t unlocked yet[/p][/*][*][p]The Overtime Assignment can be played on threat 4[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where waypoints weren’t being added to scanners before picking them up when playing Planetary Defense in a permanent location[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Roachard sometimes cutting himself off if he was talking when the extraction objective began[/p][/*][*][p]Employee XP gained from side objectives, Incursion rooms, and Paid Time Off objectives is shown in the end-of-mission screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could abort an Ouroboros mission while in the process of continuing to another level[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance to receive Lottery Larry Tokens from completing side objectives[/p][/*][*][p]After completing the main objective of Regulated Rampage, enemy spawning returns to normal to give you some breathing room[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upgrades[/h2][list][*][p]You can hold CTRL/L3 in the upgrade screen to view the order in which upgrades are applied[/p][/*][*][p]Icons below the upgrade grid are now displayed in the order they’re applied in[/p][/*][*][p]Unified the displayed horizontal/vertical stats for spread and recoil when both are the same[/p][/*][*][p]//ERROR_REDACTED// will always appear in the mission select if your Gunship Cannon has reached level 5 and you haven’t found a //______//[/p][/*][*][p]Employee upgrade trees now start at rare upgrades to give you more interesting early-game options. Standard employee upgrades drop randomly from any source.[/p][/*][*][p]Stats of employee upgrades acquired from the upgrade tree are randomized per-save instead of having the same seed for everyone[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the color of Bruiser’s Nose Dive impact and made it change color when it applies an element[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Energy Convergence stacks wouldn’t get removed when replacing the Cycler with another weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Skin previews in your inventory more closely match what the skin actually looks like when it has glowing parts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other Stuff[/h2][list][*][p]You can reequip your weapons and punch again sooner after punching[/p][/*][*][p]Employee levels no longer show as infinity after reaching level 30[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Swarm Launcher bullets fired with Guidance Array would appear to be fired in the wrong direction for other players[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed Shock Grenade to Voltaic Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed Acid Grenade to Caustic Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Cycler elemental upgrades no longer require gats to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]Dead player parts despawn if their player leaves the game[/p][/*][*][p]Added a minimum level requirement to Abomination Assault and Ouroboros[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the levels at which certain special missions unlock[/p][/*][*][p]Added recommended mission popups for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the team revive screen effect color[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where acid puddle sounds wouldn’t immediately stop when the puddle disappears[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the drop pod shaking your screen even when you weren’t inside when it departs from a mission[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive ball shrooms deal a bit of damage to players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed //ERROR_REDACTED// spawning too low in the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bit of background lore the first time you launch the game[/p][/*][*][p]You can ride Terry[/p][/*][*][p]Other players (and Roachard) make footstep sounds when they walk[/p][/*][*][p]The Shocklance can only be unlocked after completing the Overtime Assignment[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option for HUD UI antialiasing which can be enabled in the graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a drop pod landing spot that was clipping through a refinery in Titan City[/p][/*][*][p]Texture streaming budget defaults to 4096mb if the game can’t detect how much VRAM your system has on first launch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a short freeze when loading an image data log[/p][/*][*][p]Improved GPU rendering performance in the Ice Floes permanent location and in procedural levels[/p][/*][*][p]Improved rendering performance of grass[/p][/*][*][p]The sunlight no longer vanishes for a moment when loading a new level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused your screen to flash if you fell out of the drop pod and died while it was leaving a mission[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the effects for Cycler’s Condensed Ejection and Trident’s Plasma Arc[/p][list][*][p]And added some new impact VFX to them[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed various VFX status effect shapes[/p][/*][*][p]Bruiser’s ground pound and shield will have different colored effects for certain upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]New screen effect for Carver’s Turkey Bloodlust[/p][/*][*][p]The gun VFX crabs now use a different emission system that makes them a little more consistent, and should prevent a rare type of crash[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to explosion and death effect visibility when up close[/p][/*][*][p]Added special VFX to Internal Combustion[/p][/*][*][p]Gave the Plate Launcher a new trail, and tweaked its muzzle flash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Roachard wasn’t munching when the employees scolded him for munching[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some incorrect timings on conversations between employees[/p][/*][*][p]Ability colors use your custom UI color[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to change your voice chat input device[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where repeatedly playing emotes in third person that only affected your arms wouldn’t restart the animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could sometimes spawn in the HUB with no weapon equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades from Ouroboros that aren’t normally stackable no longer say stackable in the cleanse screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]The Balancing[/h1][p][/p][h2]TLDR (New Upgrades & Turbocharges)[/h2][list][*][p]Cycler[/p][list][*][p]Subzero Energy[/p][list][*][p]Bullets apply [i]cryo[/i]. Fire rate is decreased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Au-Si Jackrabbit[/p][list][*][p]Flamethrower [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Flamethrower damage is increased while you are ignited.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All Powdered Up [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]While airborne, the Jackrabbit deals more damage the higher you are above your target.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]DMLR[/p][list][*][p]Stormcloud Accumulator[/p][list][*][p]Firing the DMR or laser spawns [i]cryo[/i] shards. Can be stacked.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Swarm Launcher[/p][list][*][p]Breeding Season [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Pellets spawned by this upgrade deal increased damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Plate Launcher[/p][list][*][p]Charging Port[/p][list][*][p]Intermittently heal while standing on one of your plates.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gunship Cannon[/p][list][*][p]Tinderbox [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Changes Tinderbox element to [i]shock[/i] or [i]acid[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Trident[/p][list][*][p]Plasma Arc[/p][list][*][p]Fire a single arc of plasma that deals damage in a small area.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Globbler[/p][list][*][p]Solidified Acid[/p][list][*][p]Impact damage is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pressure Cooker [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Magazine size +1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Carver[/p][list][*][p]Turkey’s Bloodlust[/p][list][*][p]Hold Reload to consume all [i]blood[/i], increasing your damage for a while for each consumed stack. You can’t gain [i]blood[/i] while this effect is active.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Accelerator[/p][list][*][p]Confident Queen[/p][list][*][p]Dealing damage with your other weapon no longer refills the Accelerator’s magazine. Ammo capacity is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Incendiary Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Hearth & Home [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Your secondary ability recharges faster when near your last explosion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Voltaic Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Flash Storm [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Lightning damage is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Caustic Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Heavy Support [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Your heavy weapons deal more damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overclock [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Gain damage resistance after getting hit by an overclocked explosion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Connected Systems [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Triggers an additional time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Photon Disc[/p][list][*][p]Harmonizer [i]Turbocharged[/i][/p][list][*][p]Elemental chance is further increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Infusion Effectiveness[/h2][p]Upgrade effectiveness is affected by how much its pattern size has changed. Infusing a smaller pattern into an upgrade will reduce the effectiveness of most of its stats, while infusing a larger pattern will improve its stats![/p][p][/p][h2]Weapons[/h2][p]G6 Streetsweeper[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the range at which damage begins to decrease by 4m[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A16 Beam Ripper[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage by 40%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Laser Cannon[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage by 20%[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced recoil[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The Last Argument[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage by 40%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Shocklance[/p][list][*][p]Increased base damage by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Damage decreases by an additional 11% for each pierced target[/p][/*][*][p][i]Our aim with this change is to move more of the Shocklance’s damage to the first few targets hit by its coil and make it a bit more useful against single targets. Hitting 9 targets will deal roughly the same total damage as before. Hitting fewer than 9 will deal more damage than before, and hitting more than 9 deals less damage than before.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upgrades[/h2][list][*][p]Employee[/p][list][*][p]Elemental Cocktail’s rarity is now Exotic[/p][/*][*][p]Frantic Greed[/p][list][*][p]Shooting a health chunk also creates an elemental explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Also triggers when killing a battery grunt[/p][/*][*][p]Changed pattern[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Boost Buffer[/p][list][*][p]Changed pattern[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Wrangler[/p][list][*][p]Tumbleweed - It feels incredible to reach this milestone, and we wanted to use that as an excuse to show some more stuff from behind the scenes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/518290a2a5b5c63266424664026b1b65fa189377.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/18820f4db8cdd9555024dd60dfb70d6575931bc5.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]mycopunk prototype circa 2023 ^[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We are very lucky to be surrounded by a wealth of supporters, friends, and family who all helped get us to this point. newsitems.title: Myco-eve: Employees, Weapons & Grenades
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [p]Happy Myco-Eve everyone![/p][p]This feels like a good excuse to gush about the NEW STUFF we’ve been cooking up. I am of course referring to a whole new character, as well as a new gun and a new grenade.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the things that crept up on us a little was how much our past content would stack up. Since launching into EA we’ve added a lot of new upgrades and skins, which can give new content a bit of a hollow feeling when it doesn’t have that history behind it…[/p][p]So we just had to add it in :p[/p][p]We’re very happy with the care that’s been put into these new additions. And can confidently say that the new stuff is coming with a healthy suite of upgrades AND skins that feel at home with everything else. For the new employee specifically this means she’s got versions of most event skins AND an Amalgamation exclusive character upgrade (I got to make more tentacles for it, it’s sick).[/p][p][/p][h2]Snowball Grenade[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/de23594131fb353c570aab76626a3fa74b477216.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Starting off with the Snowball Grenade, I will say that likely no one’s surprised that cryo made it into the game. Once you have an elemental system, it’s only a matter of time before something ice related shows up. It is, however, probably the largest surprise to US as the devs. We hadn’t originally planned on making two new grenades before final release. One maybe, but TWO?! You gotta be joking, that’s like, two of them.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate the early feedback we received about grenades and elemental uniqueness. And while there aren’t any plans for changing how existing statuses behave, we wanted to make the Snowball Grenade and, and cryo in general, feel sufficiently different. Somewhat on the opposite end of the spectrum from the Photon Disc, the Snowball’s got an incredible CC ability that helps control the pace of a fight instead of just killing things (which it also can, very effectively).[/p][p][/p][p]It's got a lot of cool upgrades, which I don’t wanna spoil, but I WILL say that my personal favorite allows you to roll it down a hill like to gain size like a cartoon.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Diffraction Driver[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/407a7b58f61e974fb7f74642dfc61e531d92df4b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/31bd6c0590ac0ad3a6172d435e1f95a5e0de31de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]NEW WEAPON WOOOOOO![/p][p]I love the Diffraction Driver, this thing’s sweet. Our design principle for weapons has always been to make something that’s unique enough on its own without any upgrades, which really comes through with this one.[/p][p][/p][p]By default it’s a wide-cone shotgun that provides incredibly consistent damage within a good area, making it an excellent middle ground close quarters weapon between the Jackrabbit and the Carver. Holding alt-fire though will spin up its halo, tightening the spread and increasing the range when higher accuracy is in demand.[/p][p][/p][h2]The New Employee[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/3840fdf399c434ec5fc5c101121318773ff83334.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/c3799b2905309fea55ca9aa0925302a9645d08bf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our FIRST new employee is now my favorite employee.[/p][p]The design philosophy for the original cast was centered around giving everyone a different way to help their team, which worked really well for tightening up the original version of the game. With those four walls being quite solid, we found ourselves without an obvious niche that needed to be filled. Turns out that meant we could get FREAKY with it, and just make an employee that’s FUN, based generally around the idea of: ‘what if someone got fungussed, and lived?’[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, she’s been shuffled around quite a bit since her original concept, but what didn’t work for her base kit often made for an excellent upgrade which allowed us to flesh her out very quickly. And we’re happy to finally have a place for the Infection mechanic (which started as a generic debuff), as a manageable resource that gives fun synergies to her upgrades and combat pacing.[/p][p][/p][p]It is with the utmost pleasure that we can put the [i][b]Mycologist[/b][/i] in your (capable) hands TOMORROW!!![/p][p][/p][h2]A Supporter Pack[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/4035d00ae52dfee0a81ddadadf2251dfed12d23a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Along with 1.0, we’re releasing a super special supporter DLC that comes with some fun goodies, including a chrome skin for each employee, some sick reload animation variants, and two [i]exotic[/i] skins that give Glider and Scrapper new character models! But really, this pack is meant to be a way for you to support us if you love what we’re doing :3[/p][p]And if you don’t want it, we still love you, and so does Roachard.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See ya’ll then![/p]

newsitems.title: 1.0 and the Moon
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello all![/p][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to be so close to our full release on TUESDAY BABY CAN YOU BELIEVE THAT?![/p][p]We can’t.[/p][p][/p][p]What we [i]can[/i] believe though, is that New Atlas’ moon, X11-B, will be seeing its first tourism since it was named (or… since it was designated as ‘inhospitable’).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/76fa4475cddb5816e370f107d48949b4bf8d7391.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our goal with X11-B was to make a region that adds challenge for those who have been playing since we launched into Early Access. We’re doing this so that we can try and keep even the most augmented employees on their toes. Because of this, we wanted to put this region on a whole moonlet of its own so that it stands apart from the rest, both in its mechanics and its style.[/p][p][/p][p]As we’ve mentioned before, there’s already stuff in the works for some post-release content updates. Part of what we’re exploring for those updates involves even more regions with even more pizazz, so we’re excited to see how ya’ll engage with this little moonlet as our first dip into more of an alien environment.[/p][p][/p][p]But that’s enough about the future, we’ve got more stuff to talk about that’s OLD![/p][p]There’s a heap of upgrade tuning coming up, the focus being on making underwhelming upgrades a bit more usable. But a healthy sandbox requires a bit more gardening than that, so we’ve also added a few new upgrades to existing weapons and turbocharged a some more exotics. Take a look:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Subzero Energy (Cycler Epic)[/p][list][*][p]Bullets apply [i]cryo[/i]. Fire rate is decreased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stormcloud Accumulator (DMLR Epic)[/p][list][*][p]Firing the DMR or laser spawns [i]cryo[/i] shards. Can be stacked.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Charging Port (Plate Launcher Epic)[/p][list][*][p]Intermittently heal while standing on one of your plates.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Plasma Arc (Trident Exotic)[/p][list][*][p]Fire a single arc of plasma that deals damage in a small area.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Solidified Acid (Globbler Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Impact damage is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Turkey's Bloodlust (Carver Exotic)[/p][list][*][p]Hold Reload to consume all [i]blood[/i], increasing your damage for a while for each consumed stack. You can't gain [i]blood[/i] while this effect is active.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Confident Queen (Accelerator Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Dealing damage with your other weapon no longer refills the Accelerator's magazine. Ammo capacity is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Turbocharges[/b][/p][list][*][p](Jackrabbit) Flamethrower Turbocharge[/p][list][*][p]Flamethrower damage is increased while you are ignited.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Jackrabbit) All Powdered Up Turbocharge[/p][list][*][p]While airborne, the Jackrabbit deals more damage the higher you are above your target.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Swarm Launcher) Breeding Season Turbocharge[/p][list][*][p]Pellets spawned by this upgrade deal increased damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Gunship Cannon) Tinderbox Turbocharge[/p][list][*][p]Changes Tinderbox element to [i]shock[/i] or [i]acid[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Globbler) Pressure Cooker Turbocharge[/p][list][*][p]Magazine Size +1[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Incendiary Grenade) Hearth & Home[/p][list][*][p]Your secondary ability recharges faster when near your last explosion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Voltaic Grenade) (yes it’s been renamed) Flash Storm[/p][list][*][p]Lightning damage is increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Caustic Grenade) (yes it’s also been renamed) Heavy Support[/p][list][*][p]Your heavy weapons deal more damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Caustic Grenade) Overclock[/p][list][*][p]Gain damage resistance after getting hit by an overclocked explosion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Caustic Grenade) Connected Systems[/p][list][*][p]Triggers an additional time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](Photon Disc) Harmonizer[/p][list][*][p]Elemental chance is further increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/c570f1f70ec56b12847a1a85866a8f192b221794.jpg"][/img][/p]

newsitems.title: Pigeons at Devlog 9/11/26
newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [p]Howdy[/p][p][/p][p]Last week i spent a few hours tracking down a crash that sometimes happens when exiting to the main menu. With most crashes, I can find the cause pretty easily by having the game write to the log file at specific points so I can see exactly where it fails (or if I’m really lucky, the log will already have an error from whatever caused the crash).[/p][p][/p][p]No such luck this time. The menu initialized just fine - it was only a few frames after loading the menu that the crash actually occurred. I made a special build of the game with a loop that infinitely hosts, returns to the menu, and hosts again, because my fingers were getting tired. When the crash finally happened, I opened the Windows Event Viewer (amazing UI, I know) to find this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/9b9ac7be3cd3899cb38fb300fc1ac8a587e522fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Turns out, the crash was triggering from the discord sdk, which means I messed something up in our voice chat implementation. Due to some stupidity on my end , the voice chat call wasn’t ended for a moment after leaving a lobby, but the discord voice lobby associated with the in-game lobby [i]was[/i] left, so the call was trying to access memory that the lobby had already freed.[/p][p][/p][p]In the end, all I had to do was reorder a few lines of code.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Infusion Changes[/h2][p][/p][p]I’ve been working on a big change coming to pattern infusion - in 1.0 most upgrade stats will be affected by the size of their upgrade patterns. This helps balance out being able to make large upgrades a lot smaller, but it also buffs upgrades if you infuse a [i]larger[/i] pattern into them, which should make for some interesting build choices. Upgrades whose stats depend on surrounding cells aren’t affected by this change.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/049fd54321aba4632bcbf10ac68aba3f9afc8177.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8c4b3387643c157fa25efbbbc329b93263dc20ab.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]-Liam[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Grabbing This Little Goober[/h2][p][/p][p]Recently I’ve been making some new fungifal effects, and everything’s gotta get tested somehow…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/e539158041ae44883cbdfd1971bc6a9509e5765e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This snippet is only a small part of a much larger effect that will attach to several different things at a time. On the technical side of things, the system uses a buffer, a container for data that keeps track of targets, their size, and their position to dictate how many tendrils to make, and where they should go (currently this buffer only contains a single Roachard).[/p][p][/p][p]When it comes to effects like this, I want them to feel very tactile to capture the fear (or other emotion…) that many grabbing tentacles might evoke. For me this translates into a lot of whipping motion when they attach, and wiggling with ‘strain’ to give the illusion of tension. The physics here are completely faked however, unlike a similar effect: the line on Scrapper’s Grapple Pole. In the case of the grappling line, it’s of very little consequence what happens to it after it’s released, which gives us the luxury of that super elastic spring & reeling motion. For these tentacles though, which will be very numerous and provide valuable information to the player, I don’t want to be meeting a physics system in the middle. Even if that means more effort towards an incredibly similar (and potentially stiffer) result, in my opinion it’s always worth knowing how and when to fake your physics for the sake of getting the player the information they need.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re working very hard on 1.0, which is beyond exciting for all of us. But as much as I’d like to gush about all the cool new stuff we’re working on, I believe it’s all best left behind the curtain for now…[/p][p][/p][p][i]-Noah[/i][/p]

newsitems.contents: [list][*][p]Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when returning to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with how POIs and side objectives were sorted[/p][/*][*][p]Autocannons won’t spawn in the tutorial mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed popup info being allowed to clip off the sides of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing face in one of the Ouroboros rooms[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.author: Pigeons at Play
newsitems.contents: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain skins would sometimes not appear when selecting a skin at Lottery Larry (most often with Skeletal Ghost skins)[/p][/*][*][p]Also fixed an issue where Larry would only give Skeletal Ghost skins with Entombed, which is only supposed to come from ghost skins that drop in the world. Don’t worry, I disciplined him.[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby filter threat level slider was a bad boy and showed threat 8, which isn’t a thing (yet). We taught him a lesson.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the popup info when hovering over skins at Lottery Larry was sometimes anchored incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a level milestone that showed you unlocked something at level 20 that wasn’t part of this update. Oops[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ice Skates effects not stopping after unequipping the upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where picking up an upgrade from the grid or temp storage while using a controller would teleport the floating cursor to the right side of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mission objects like power relays being able to spawn inside abandoned trainyards in the swamp[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted our change that lowered the trigger threshold for firing weapons on a controller, as it had some unintentional side effects/bugs. We’ll see about making the trigger threshold a slider in the control settings in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where vehicles weren’t getting despawned anymore after aborting a mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to request vehicles in Incursion[/p][/*][/list]
